blocks.title: Electrophilic addition
blocks.text: Woh reactions jin mein alkene ke double bond par electrophile (electron ka bhooka reagent) jurta hai, electrophilic addition reactions kehlati hain.
Alkenes mein electrophilic addition ka mechanism

Alkenes ka C=C aisi jagah hai jahan electrons bohat zyada hain (high electron density), is liye electrophiles is par aasani se hamla karte hain. Alkene electrophile se react kar ke carbocation intermediate (beech mein banne wala aarzi zarra) banata hai, jo phir nucleophile se react karta hai. Figure 11.13 ke aam mechanism mein X⁺ electrophile hai aur Y⁻ nucleophile.

blocks.alt: Oopar: ethene, double bond shaded, double bond se X+ (electrophile) ki taraf surkh curly teer; phir X-CH2-CH2+, surkh teer 'carbocation' ki taraf. Neeche: carbocation X-C-C+ aur Y- (nucleophile), Y- se C+ tak surkh curly teer; phir X-CH2-CH2-Y.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.13: Electrophilic addition ka aam mechanism (kitab ki Figure 11.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle step mein double bond ke π electrons X⁺ ko pakarte hain: X aik carbon se jur jata hai aur doosre carbon par positive charge (carbocation) reh jata hai. Doosre step mein Y⁻ apna electron pair de kar is positive carbon se jur jata hai. Aakhir mein double bond ki jagah X aur Y dono jur chuke hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Alkenes electrophile ke saath kaise react karte hain (Quick Check 11.6a, 11.7c)?
blocks.explanation: Double bond ke π electrons electrophile (maslan H⁺ ya δ⁺ Br) par hamla karte hain aur us se aik naya σ bond banate hain. Doosre carbon par positive charge reh jata hai (carbocation). Phir nucleophile (maslan Br⁻) is carbocation se jur jata hai aur addition product banta hai.

blocks.text: Is chapter mein sirf halogen ke addition aur hydrogen halide ke addition ka mechanism parhenge.
1. Halogenation

Halogenation ka matlab hai chlorine ya bromine jaise halogens ka addition (jurna). Jab bromine water (pani mein bromine ka surkh-bhoora solution) carbon tetrachloride jaise inert (react na karne wale) solvent mein ethene par dala jata hai to us ka surkh-bhoora rang foran ghaib ho jata hai. Is reaction se pata chalta hai ke organic compound unsaturated hai (us mein double bond hai).
Mechanism
Yeh reaction teen steps mein hoti hai:

i) Bromine (Br₂) non-polar molecule hai. Lekin jab bromine molecule alkene ke double bond ke qareeb aata hai to double bond ke zyada electrons Br–Br ke electron pair ko qareeb wale Br atom se door dhakel dete hain. Is wajah se double bond ke sab se qareeb wala Br atom thora positive (δ⁺) ho jata hai aur electrophile ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.alt: Ethene, double bond shaded, khokhla teer 'High area of electron density, Non-polar molecule'. Br2 do dashed electron badalon ki shakal mein: delta+ Br ('Electrophile') aur delta- Br: ('Induced Dipole'); likha hai 'The double bond repels the electrons away from the closest Br atom'.
blocks.caption: Qadam (i): double bond Br2 mein dipole paida karta hai (kitab ke safha 260 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: ii) Double bond ke π electrons Br₂ ke δ⁺ bromine par hamla karte hain, aur yeh partial positive bromine alkene ke C=C bond se electrons ka aik pair le leta hai. Is se bohat reactive carbocation intermediate banta hai.
iii) Yeh carbocation intermediate Br⁻ (nucleophile) se react kar ke product banata hai. Mechanism Figure 11.14 mein hai.

blocks.alt: Mechanism: ethene, C=C se Br-Br ke delta+ Br tak curly teer, aur Br-Br bond se delta- Br tak curly teer; ethene ke neeche surkh khokhla teer 'Donates electrons pair to Br+'. 'Room Temp.' wala teer primary carbocation H-CH(Br)-CH(+)-H tak, jis par :Br- hamla karta hai (curly teer); neeche teer 1,2-dibromoethane tak, har carbon par Br.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.14: Ethene aur Br2 ka electrophilic addition mechanism (kitab ki Figure 11.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Br₂ khud non-polar hai; ethene ka double bond qareeb wale Br ke electrons ko door dhakelta hai, is liye qareeb wala Br δ⁺ (electrophile) aur door wala δ⁻ ban jata hai: induced dipole (bahar ke asar se bana dipole). Phir π electrons δ⁺ Br par hamla karte hain, Br–Br bond ke electrons doosre Br ke paas chale jate hain (Br⁻), aur carbocation banta hai jis se Br⁻ jur kar 1,2-dibromoethane banata hai.
2. Hydrohalogenation
Jab alkene room temperature par khushk (dry) hydrogen halide gas se react karta hai to halogenoalkane banta hai.

Hydrogen halides un sab se saade polar substances mein se hain jin ke permanent dipoles hote hain aur jo alkenes se jurte hain (Figure 11.15). Tamam hydrogen halides (HBr, HCl, HI, HF) yeh reaction karte hain aur C=C par bilkul aik hi tarah jurte hain. Magar reaction ki speed (rate) HF se HI ki taraf barhti hai. Kaun sa product banega, yeh is par depend karta hai ke alkene symmetrical (dono taraf aik jaisa) hai ya unsymmetrical.

blocks.alt: H-Br: H par delta+, Br par delta-, dipole teer Br ki taraf. H hare daire mein, 'Electrophile'. Dabbe: 'Pulls the electrons more strongly towards itself' (Br); 'Has lower electronegativity than Br so is electron deficient' (H).
blocks.caption: Figure 11.15: HBr molecule ki polarity (kitab ki Figure 11.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: i) Symmetrical alkenes par addition: Jab alkene (maslan ethene) symmetrical ho to sirf aik product mumkin hai. Ethene par HBr ke addition ka mechanism dekhte hain.
Mechanism:

items: Nucleophilic π bond hydrogen halide ke hydrogen par hamla karta hai. Hydrogen bromide se bromide ion (Br⁻) banta hai. Double bond wale aik carbon par hydrogen jurne se ethene carbocation ban jati hai.
Bromide ion (nucleophile) carbocation par hamla karta hai aur addition product banta hai (Figure 11.16).

blocks.alt: Ethene, C=C se H-Br ke delta+ H tak curly teer, aur H-Br bond se Br tak curly teer. Teer carbocation H-CH2-CH(+)-H tak, jis par :Br- hamla karta hai; neeche teer 1-Bromoethane (alkyl halide) tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.16: Ethene par HBr ka electrophilic addition mechanism (kitab ki Figure 11.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: ii) Unsymmetrical alkenes par addition: Jab alkene unsymmetrical ho to do products mumkin hain. Maslan propene par HBr ke addition se do products ban sakte hain. Lekin tajurbe (experiment) se pata chala hai ke in halaat mein major (zyada banne wala) product 2-bromopropane hai aur minor (kam banne wala) product 1-bromopropane.
Alkenes ki addition reactions par Markovnikov’s Rule lagta hai. Is rule ke mutabiq,

blocks.title: Markovnikov’s Rule
blocks.text: “Jab polar reagent unsymmetrical alkene se jurta hai to reagent ka negative hissa double bond ke us carbon se jurta hai jis par hydrogen kam hon.”
Mechanism
Propene HBr se do tarah react karti hai. Is ke mechanism ke steps yeh hain.

items: C=C ke π electrons H–Br ke partial positive sire (H) par hamla karte hain. Hydrogen bromide heterolytically toot-ta hai aur bromide ion (nucleophile) banta hai. Hydrogen double bond ke us carbon se jurta hai jis par zyada hydrogen hain, aur 2º (secondary) carbocation banta hai.
Bromide ion secondary carbocation par hamla kar ke major product banata hai. Minor product primary carbocation par hamle se banta hai (Figure 11.17).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein bromide ion ko ‘(electrophile)’ likha hai. Bromide ion (Br⁻) nucleophile hai, kyunke woh carbocation ko apna electron pair deta hai (step ii bhi yahi kehta hai).

blocks.alt: Propene, sab bonds ke saath; us ke C=C se H-Br ke delta+ H tak curly teer aur H-Br bond se Br tak. Room Temp: H CH2 sire par jurta hai, secondary carbocation CH3-CH(+)-CH3, :Br- hamla, 2-bromopropane (major product). Neeche wala rasta: H darmiyani carbon par, primary carbocation CH3-CH2-CH2(+), :Br- hamla, 1-bromopropane (minor product).
blocks.caption: Figure 11.17: Propene par HBr ka electrophilic addition mechanism (kitab ki Figure 11.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Propene par H do jagah jur sakta hai. Agar H CH₂ wale sire par jure to beech wale carbon par secondary carbocation banta hai, jo do alkyl groups ki wajah se zyada stable hai; is liye 2-bromopropane major product hai. Agar H beech wale carbon par jure to primary carbocation banta hai jo kam stable hai, is liye 1-bromopropane minor product hai. Yahi Markovnikov’s Rule hai.

blocks.caption: Electrophilic additions
rows: polar bana Br₂ ka δ⁺ Br

blocks.prompt: HCl, HBr aur HI ke alkenes par addition ke rates ka muqabla karein, aur 2-pentene par HBr ke addition mein Markovnikov’s rule kaise lagta hai (Quick Check 11.7a, d)?
blocks.explanation: Rate HCl < HBr < HI hai, kyunke H–X bond HCl se HI tak kamzor hota jata hai aur H⁺ aasani se alag hota hai. 2-Pentene (CH₃CH=CHCH₂CH₃) mein double bond ke dono carbons par aik aik hydrogen hai, is liye Markovnikov’s rule aik product nahi chunta: dono carbocations secondary hain, aur 2-bromopentane aur 3-bromopentane dono taqreeban barabar bante hain.

blocks.text: 3. Hydrogenation
Hydrogenation ka matlab hai catalyst (Ni ya Pt) ki maujoodgi mein 250–300 °C par alkene par hydrogen molecule ka jurna, jis se saturated compound banta hai.
Industry mein is reaction se vegetable oil (banaspati tel) ko margarine (banaspati ghee) mein badla jata hai.
4. Hydration
Gaseous alkenes zyada temperature aur pressure par, concentrated acid (H₂SO₄) ko catalyst bana kar, steam (bhaap) se react karte hain aur alcohols banate hain.
Hydrohalogenation ki tarah alkene pehle carbocation intermediate banata hai, jis par phir OH⁻ hamla karta hai.
5. Halohydration

Halohydration woh reaction hai jis mein alkene pani ki maujoodgi mein halogen (jaise bromine ya chlorine) se react kar ke halohydrin banata hai. Ethene (C₂H₄) se halogen ke mutabiq bromohydrin ya chlorohydrin banti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein product CH₃–CH(Br)OH chhapa hai, yani Br aur OH dono aik hi carbon par, aur naam ‘1-Bromo-2-ethanol’; equation balanced bhi nahi. Sahi yeh hai ke Br aur OH double bond ke do alag carbons par jurte hain: Br–CH₂–CH₂–OH (2-bromoethanol), aur saath HBr banta hai.
6. Epoxidation

blocks.title: Epoxide
blocks.text: Alkenes ki epoxidation se oxygen wala teen konon ka cyclic ether (halqa) banta hai jise epoxide kehte hain.

Ethene (C₂H₄) ki epoxidation mukhtalif oxidizing agents se ki ja sakti hai. Ethene ko oxygen molecule aur metal catalyst se bhi ethylene oxide mein badla ja sakta hai. Transition metal catalyst (jaise Ag) reaction ko aasan karta hai aur alkene se seedha epoxide banata hai. Epoxides ko acid hydrolysis (acid aur pani se torna) se diols (do OH wale compounds) mein badla ja sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Ethene + O2, 'Ag' wala teer, epoxide (do CH2 carbons aur ek O ka teen-rukni halqa), 'H+/H2O' wala teer, ethane-1,2-diol H2C(OH)-CH2(OH).
blocks.caption: Ethene ki epoxidation aur epoxide ki hydrolysis (kitab ke safha 263 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 7. Ozonolysis

Ozonolysis ozone (O₃), jo oxygen ka reactive allotrope (doosri shakal) hai, se alkenes ko oxidation ke zariye kaatne ka tareeqa hai. Is reaction se aksar namaloom alkenes ki structure pehchani jati hai: alkene ko chhote, aasani se pehchane jane wale tukron mein tor diya jata hai. Alkenes ozone (O₃) se react kar ke ozonides banate hain, jo reduce ho kar carbonyl compounds (aldehydes ya ketones) aur aakhir mein alcohols ban sakte hain.

blocks.alt: 1-Propene H3C-CH=CH2 O3 ke saath ozonide deti hai: O-O, CH2, O aur H3C wale HC ka paanch-rukni halqa. Zn/H2O se ethanal (H3C-CHO) + methanal (HCHO), C=O ke saath; reduction se ethanol H3C-CH2-OH aur methanol CH3-OH.
blocks.caption: Propene ki ozonolysis (kitab ke safha 264 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ozonolysis double bond ko tor deti hai: double bond ke har carbon par C=O ban jata hai. Is liye products dekh kar pata chalta hai ke double bond kahan tha: propene se ethanal (2 carbon) aur methanal (1 carbon) bante hain, yani double bond carbon 1 aur 2 ke darmiyan tha.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke khaake mein propene se ozonide wala teer dono taraf (reversible) chhapa hai. Ozonide ka banna aik taraf ki reaction hai, is liye oopar seedha teer hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethene ki ozonolysis likhein, but-2-ene ki epoxidation dein, aur batayein ke ozonolysis double bond ki jagah kaise batati hai (Quick Check 11.8).
blocks.explanation: Ethene: CH₂=CH₂ + O₃ → ozonide, jo Zn/H₂O se 2HCHO (do methanal) deta hai. But-2-ene silver catalyst par oxygen se (ya peroxy acid se) 2,3-dimethyloxirane deti hai, jis mein oxygen beech ke do carbons ko jorti hai. Ozonolysis molecule ko theek double bond par kaat-ti hai aur har tukra apne carbons rakhta hai; is liye do carbonyl products pehchan kar bond ki jagah pata chalti hai: ethene se do methanal, propene se ethanal aur methanal.

blocks.text: 8. Polymerization

blocks.title: Polymerization
blocks.text: Chhote reactive molecules (monomers) ke aapas mein jurne se bohat lambe molecules (polymers) ka banna polymerization kehlata hai.

Addition polymerization alkenes ki sab se aham addition reactions mein se hai aur plastics ki industry isi par khari hai. Addition polymerization woh reaction hai jis mein kam az kam aik C=C double bond wale bohat se monomers jur kar polymer ki lambi chains banate hain, aur koi doosra product nahi banta.

Alkenes ki doosri addition reactions ki tarah har monomer ke C=C double bond ka π bond toot-ta hai aur monomers naye C–C single bonds se aapas mein jur jate hain. Polymer lambi chain wala molecule hai jo bohat se repeating units (baar baar aane wale hisson) se bana hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein likha hai ke ‘each C-C bond’ ka π bond toot-ta hai. Single C–C bond mein π bond nahi hota; jo π bond toot-ta hai woh monomer ke C=C double bond ka hai.

blocks.alt: Do qataren. n ethene (H2C=CH2), 'Polymerization' teer, poly(ethene): murabba brackets mein -CH2-CH2-, neeche n; labels Monomer aur Polymer. n chloroethene (H2C=CHCl), 'Polymerization', poly(chloroethene) (PVC): brackets mein -CH2-CHCl-, n.
blocks.caption: Ethene aur chloroethene ki addition polymerisation (kitab ke safha 264 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: n ka matlab hai bohat se monomers. Har monomer ka C=C khul kar single bond ban jata hai aur monomers aik doosre se jur jate hain; square brackets ke andar aik repeating unit hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke PVC wale repeating unit mein chlorine ki jagah sirf ‘C’ chhapa hai; sahi Cl hai (har doosre carbon par aik Cl), jaisa oopar diagram mein hai.

blocks.title: Interesting Information!
blocks.text: Ethene aur propene jaise alkenes se polymerization ke zariye plastics banaye jate hain. Maslan ethene ko polymerize kar ke polyethylene banti hai, jo duniya ke sab se aam plastics mein se hai aur thailiyon, botalon aur packing mein istemal hoti hai.
Kitab mein aik ball pen ki tasveer hai: yeh ball pen PVC se bana hai.
Repeating units nikalna

items: Repeating unit atoms ka sab se chhota group hai jo aik ke baad aik jur kar polymer ki chain banata hai. Displayed aur general formula mein ise square brackets [ ] mein dikhate hain.

Aik hi qisam ke monomer se bane poly(alkenes) (jaise poly(ethene)) aur substituted poly(alkenes) (jaise PVC) mein repeating unit monomer jaisa hi hota hai, bas C=C double bond C–C single bond mein badal jata hai.

blocks.alt: n ethene (monomer), teer, brackets mein poly(ethene) aur n (polymer), surkh teer, chaar CH2 carbons ki zanjeer sab H ke saath, do carbons ke neeche qaus 'Repeating unit'.
blocks.caption: Poly(ethene) ki repeating unit nikalna (kitab ke safha 265 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke poly(ethene) wali zanjeer ke khaake mein ek hydrogen atom chhapne se reh gaya hai. Zanjeer ka har carbon CH2 hai (do hydrogen), is liye oopar khaake mein tamam hydrogen banaye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt: Ethene ki kaun si structure use polymerization ke qabil banati hai, is reaction mein hybridization aur bond angle kaise badalte hain, aur addition se molecule zyada saturated kyun ho jata hai (Quick Check 11.9)?
blocks.explanation: Ethene mein C=C ka kamzor π bond hai jo aasani se khul kar har carbon ko aik nayi bond ki jagah deta hai; is se monomers aapas mein jur sakte hain. Reaction mein har carbon sp² (120º, planar) se sp³ (109.5º, tetrahedral) ban jata hai. Addition mein double bond khul kar single bonds ban jate hain aur carbons par zyada atoms jur jate hain, is liye product zyada saturated hota hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Electrophilic addition: electrophile π electrons par hamla karta hai, carbocation banta hai, nucleophile reaction poori karta hai.
Br₂ (induced dipole; bromine water ka rang ghaib = unsaturation ka test) → 1,2-dibromoethane; HBr → bromoethane; propene + HBr: Markovnikov, secondary carbocation, 2-bromopropane major.

Hydrogenation (H₂, Ni, 250–300 °C; oil se margarine), hydration (steam, H₂SO₄ → ethanol), halohydration (Br₂/H₂O → 2-bromoethanol), epoxidation (O₂/Ag; hydrolysis se diol), ozonolysis (O₃, Zn/H₂O → carbonyls; C=C ki jagah), addition polymerization (poly(ethene), PVC; repeating unit).
